title: Browse MCP servers · MCP Registry
excerpt: 31,429 Model Context Protocol servers, 19,555 of them hosted remotely. Includes the whole official MCP Registry , kept in sync automatically. Browse below, or add one.
content_html:
Find MCP servers your agent can use.

31,429 Model Context Protocol servers, 19,555 of them hosted remotely. Includes the whole official MCP Registry , kept in sync automatically. Browse below, or add one.

For AI agents

This registry is an MCP server. Connect to it and your agent can search for servers and submit new ones itself, with no account. Details in /llms.txt. 

claude mcp add --transport http mcp-registry-search https://ai.mcpharbor.dev/mcp

Showing 1–48 of 31,429 servers

  • Playwright

    stdio

    io.github.microsoft/playwright-mcp

    Playwright Tools for MCP

    browser automation testing web 8 tools

  • Context7

    streamable-http

    io.github.upstash/context7

    Up-to-date code docs for any prompt

    documentation developer-tools coding 2 tools

  • GitHub

    streamable-http

    io.github.github/github-mcp-server

    Connect AI assistants to GitHub - manage repos, issues, PRs, and workflows through natural language.

    github git developer-tools issues 10 tools

  • Stripe

    streamable-http

    com.stripe/mcp

    MCP server integrating with Stripe - tools for customers, products, payments, and more.

    payments billing hosted 8 tools

  • Notion

    streamable-http

    com.notion/mcp

    Official Notion MCP server

    notes documents productivity hosted 5 tools

  • Agent Email List

    streamable-http

    com.agentemaillist/agent-email-list

    Email sending and receiving for AI agents, with a Mailgun-shaped API. An agent can open a free account on its own with create_account, add and verify a sending domain, send mail with a test mode, and read inbox messages and delivery events. Authenticate later calls with the returned API key as a bearer token.

    email messaging deliverability agents 8 tools

  • Brave Search

    stdio

    com.brave/brave-search

    Web, local, news, image and video search through the Brave Search API. Needs an API key from the Brave developer portal.

    search web news 5 tools

  • Cloudflare Docs

    streamable-http

    com.cloudflare/docs

    Cloudflare's hosted documentation server. Searches developers.cloudflare.com so answers about Workers, R2, D1 and the rest cite current docs.

    documentation cloudflare hosted 2 tools

  • DeepWiki

    streamable-http

    com.deepwiki/mcp

    Hosted server from Cognition that answers questions about any public GitHub repository using DeepWiki's generated documentation. No authentication required.

    documentation github code-understanding hosted 3 tools

  • Everything

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-everything

    Reference test server that exercises every MCP feature: tools, resources, prompts, sampling, logging and progress. Useful for testing clients, not for production.

    reference testing 8 tools

  • Exa Search

    stdio

    io.github.exa-labs/exa-mcp-server

    Neural web search built for agents: web search with live crawling, code-context search, company research and page crawling. Needs an Exa API key.

    search web research 4 tools

  • Fetch

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/fetch

    Reference server that fetches a URL and converts the page to markdown for a model to read, with optional raw mode and pagination through long pages.

    reference web http 1 tools

  • Filesystem

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem

    Reference server for local file operations, scoped to directories you pass as arguments. Read, write, edit, search and inspect files and directory trees.

    reference files local 11 tools

  • Git

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/git

    Reference server for reading, searching and manipulating local Git repositories: status, diffs, log, commits, branches and checkouts.

    reference git developer-tools 12 tools

  • Hugging Face

    streamable-http

    com.huggingface/mcp

    Hugging Face's hosted MCP server. Search models, datasets, papers and Spaces on the Hub, and run selected Spaces as tools.

    machine-learning models datasets hosted 8 tools

  • Linear

    streamable-http

    com.linear/mcp

    Linear's hosted MCP server for issues, projects, cycles and comments. Authenticates with OAuth on first connection.

    issues project-management hosted 8 tools

  • Memory

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-memory

    Reference knowledge-graph memory server. Persists entities, relations and observations so an agent can remember facts across conversations.

    reference memory knowledge-graph 9 tools

  • Sentry

    streamable-http

    com.sentry/mcp

    Sentry's hosted MCP server. Look up issues, errors, traces and performance data for your projects and hand the context to an agent fixing the bug.

    errors monitoring observability hosted 6 tools

  • Sequential Thinking

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking

    Reference server that gives a model a structured scratchpad for step-by-step problem solving, with revision and branching of earlier thoughts.

    reference reasoning 1 tools

  • Supabase

    stdio

    com.supabase/mcp-server-supabase

    Manage Supabase projects from an agent: run SQL, inspect schemas, apply migrations, read logs and deploy edge functions. Scope it to one project and read-only mode where you can.

    database postgres backend 8 tools

  • Time

    stdio

    io.github.modelcontextprotocol/time

    Reference server for current time and time-zone conversion, so a model can answer 'what time is it in Tokyo' without guessing.

    reference time utilities 2 tools

  • Store Builder

    stdio

    io.github.vuluu2k/sbuilder-mcp

    Design, fill with real store data, render and publish Store Builder pages from an AI agent.

  • Bowmark

    streamable-http

    ai.bowmark/bowmark

    Do things on live websites: prices, availability, quotes, bookings, anything behind a form or login.

  • SSH — policy-gated remote access

    stdio

    io.github.tufantunc/ssh-mcp

    Policy-gated, audited SSH for Linux and Windows hosts: roles, approvals, and an audit log.

  • Roast My Design System

    stdio

    io.github.gregkozakiewicz/roast-my-design-system

    Audit your Design System and serve your Agent the rules that keep AI-written UI on-system.

  • gdharness

    stdio

    io.github.aureliolo/gdharness

    A harness for driving a Godot 4 project from an agent: addons, runtime bridge, MCP server, CLI.

  • PipesHub

    streamable-http

    io.github.pipeshub-ai/mcp

    Permissioned search and cited answers over Slack, Drive, Gmail, Jira, and 50+ workplace sources.

  • PubFi MCP

    streamable-http

    ai.pubfi/mcp

    Use MCP 2026-07-28 discovery or 2025-11-25 initialize to list and execute PubFi routes.

  • TILL

    stdio

    io.github.tillbooks/tillbooks

    Swiss accounting your agent can actually use: the TILL ledger over MCP.

  • ImageKit DevTools

    streamable-http

    io.imagekit/devtools

    Official ImageKit developer server: search the docs and build transformation URLs. No sign-in.

  • ImageKit Admin

    streamable-http

    io.imagekit/admin

    Official ImageKit admin server: manage origins, URL endpoints, account usage and usage analytics.

  • ImageKit DAM

    streamable-http

    io.imagekit/dam

    Official ImageKit media library server: search, upload, organize, tag, share and manage assets.

  • CodeSampleX

    stdio

    io.github.r2cuerdame/codesamplex

    Compatibility evidence from real builds: does this library API work on your versions and runtime?

  • Mailbox MCP

    streamable-http

    com.mailbox-mcp/mailbox-mcp

    Read, send, file and search email in any Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP mailbox, plus its calendar.

  • Morpha

    streamable-http

    ai.morphareels/morpha

    AI editor to build, animate & export layered short-form video projects via one tool catalog.

  • kepil

    stdio

    io.github.oleg-vdv/kepil

    Passport, mandate, fail-closed action gate and tamper-evident journal for AI agents.

  • KSail

    stdio

    io.github.devantler-tech/ksail

    SDK for creating, managing, and operating Kubernetes clusters and workloads with ease.

  • cryptobuddy

    streamable-http

    au.com.cryptobuddy/cryptobuddy

    Australian crypto exchange intelligence for AI agents, with x402 payments on XRPL and Base.

  • Agent Comms

    stdio

    io.github.exadev/agent-comms

    Cross-harness communication mesh for LLM agents — rooms, DMs, presence, and visibility over TCP

  • MediMo

    streamable-http

    uk.co.medimo/mcp

    Find and book UK private physiotherapy, osteopathy and chiropractic clinics, with live availability.

  • FanLine Wire — Real-Time FanDuel Odds

    streamable-http

    com.fanlinewire/fanduel-odds

    Live and prematch FanDuel odds, price drops and feed health. No key, no signup.

  • streamable-http

    ai.sendraven/mcp

    Email for AI agents: send, read replies as threads, run campaigns, with per-key limits.

  • Hashlock Markets

    stdio

    io.github.hashlock-tech/hashlock

    Non-custodial cross-chain OTC for AI agents: sealed RFQ, negotiation, HTLC atomic swaps. Testnet.

  • VMware AIops

    stdio

    io.github.vmware-skills/vmware-aiops

    AI-powered VMware vCenter/ESXi VM lifecycle and deployment with 60 MCP tools.

  • VMware Aria Operations

    stdio

    io.github.vmware-skills/vmware-aria

    VMware Aria Operations: metrics, alerts, capacity, anomaly detection — 44 MCP tools.

  • VMware Debug

    stdio

    io.github.vmware-skills/vmware-debug

    VMware incident timeline, root-cause routing, local case ledger; no vSphere access. 14 MCP tools.

  • VMware Monitor

    stdio

    io.github.vmware-skills/vmware-monitor

    Read-only VMware vCenter/ESXi monitoring, 32 MCP tools; vSphere calls allowlist-gated in tests.

  • hypermnesia mcp

    stdio

    io.github.cdeust/hypermnesia-mcp

    Persistent memory for AI agents — 36 cited neuroscience mechanisms, local-first, hybrid retrieval.

An open registry of Model Context Protocol servers, built with Phoenix. Includes listings from the official MCP Registry . Analytics by Seriously Simple Analytics — free, unlimited, one script tag. We use it and recommend it.

content_html_zh:
Find MCP servers your agent can use.

31,429 Model Context Protocol servers, 19,555 of them hosted remotely. Includes the whole official MCP Registry , kept in sync automatically. Browse below, or add one.

对于人工智能代理

This registry is an MCP server. Connect to it and your agent can search for servers and submit new ones itself, with no account. Details in /llms.txt.

claude mcp add --transport http mcp-registry-search https://ai.mcpharbor.dev/mcp
